page.overview:
Who is Kiyomi Kujo?

Kiyomi is a young woman of slim build and cherry red hair, wearing purple blouse and pants with yellow polka dots along with a matching sun hat.

During her youth Kiyomi was a somewhat irresponsible parent, frequently taking sick days off work simply to enjoy time at the beach. During this period Kiyomi showcased a concerning level of self centered behavior, as she was notably displeased at Josefumi's presence stopping her from attending a beach party, and contemplated letting him drown in the sea. Although she appeared to feel genuine remorse for this and would soon after rush to save him from drowning, while previously promised herself that she would become more responsible. Following the incident, it is implied Kiyomi's relationship with Josefumi improved as she had taken various photos of him over the years and frequently continued to search for him following his disappearance as a teenager.

By 1991 in S-City of Morioh, Kioymi married a man named and had a child, who was named Josefumi Kujo by Kiyomi's father, based off the name of a geta sandal he found belonging to a young man. By the time Josefumi was a young toddler, Kiyomi and Sadafumi divorced with Kiyomi having primary custody over Josefumi. One day at the beach, Kiyomi was notified over the phone of her firing due to repeated absenteeism while claiming to be sick. Shortly after, Kiyomi witnessed Josefumi nearly swept away by the oceans waves but initially refused to save him. Contemplating that she would be unable to live a responsiblity free life, though eventually rushed to rescue him. While on the verge of death, Josefumi was treated and saved by Holy Joestar-Kira and her son Yoshikage Kira. Kiyomi was later notified by his survival by Kira who claimed she was feeling more than just relief. Over the years, Kiyomi and Josefumi assumed their normal lives, with her taking multiple photos of him as the years passed, and she eventually had another child.

By September 2011, following the earthquake and Josefumi's resulting disappearance, Kioymi continued to look for him to no avail. Near TG University Hospital, Kiyomi and her second child briefly come in contact with Yasuho Hirose upon having her dropped phone returned and head towards the Hospital. Josuke recognizing her as Josefumi's (and by extension his) mother, solemnly assuming she has forgotten about and moved on. However, Yasuho reveals Kiyomi had various photos of Josefumi saved on her phone indicating she was still cared and continued looking for him.
